evidence_quotes: Hoger beroep mestboete en beroep intrekking derogatievergunning.
De minister concludeert terecht dat gebruiksnorm dierlijke meststoffen is overschreden.
rationale: This CBb decision concerns an administrative fine (mestboete) and the revocation of a derogation permit for exceeding animal manure application standards (gebruiksnorm dierlijke meststoffen) under Dutch manure legislation (Meststoffenwet). Under the protocol rules, agricultural manure and fertiliser quota/usage-standard enforcement under the Meststoffenwet is classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related.
